explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/590: is it true that every red/blue colouring of K_{ω^ω} has a red K_{ω^ω} or a blue K₃? Yes (Chang). OrdinalCardinalRamsey α β c says every 2-colouring of the complete graph on α has a red clique of order type β or a blue clique of cardinality c. The statement is OrdinalCardinalRamsey (ω^ω) (ω^ω) 3. Faithful.
